say:6:1022101004:0.text: Valen... Yes, your swordplay is superb, but your handwriting is atrocious. I can't recognize a single word in your report.
say:6:1022101004:0.source_cn: 维伦……你的剑法利落漂亮，字迹却潦草到了极点，我完全看...

say:7:1022101005:0.text: You'll have to make do. I spend all day practicing with my sword. I don't have time for penmanship.
say:7:1022101005:0.source_cn: 这也没办法，我当年只顾着磨炼剑术，没怎么练过书法。

say:8:1022101006:0.text: No one reads these reports anyway. Stop being so serious.
say:8:1022101006:0.source_cn: 反正这些报告交上去，那些人也不会仔细看，您就别这么较真了。

say:9:1022101007:0.text: We rarely have free time like now. Let's go for a drink. I heard that Lady Joseline has something new on her menu.
say:9:1022101007:0.source_cn: 难得清闲，咱们要不要找个地方喝一杯？据我所知，乔思琳女...

say:10:1022101008:0.text: And you want me to pay for the drinks...
say:10:1022101008:0.source_cn: 你想让我请客，看出来了。
